 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.

Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.

The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. **The Opportunity**
 We are seeking an experienced GRC Archer Developer with 3–5 years of hands on experience in designing, developing, and supporting RSA Archer solutions. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of GRC processes, the Archer data model, and end to end configuration of use cases. Experience with other GRC tools like SNOW, IBM OpenPages, and ProcessUnity will be considered a strong advantage.

* Ensure adherence to GRC best practices, data governance, security standards, and platform guidelines.
* Monitor platform performance and support continuous improvement activities.

* Strong expertise in configuring Archer components:
+ Applications, Subforms, Fields, Access Control
+ Workflows including Advanced Workflows \& DDEs
+ Notifications, Data Feeds, Calculated Fields
+ Search, Reports, Dashboards

* Solid understanding of Archer's Data Model, Record Permissions, and Role\-based Access Control (RBAC).
* Experience working with key Archer modules such as:
+ Issues Management
+ Risk Registers
+ Policy, Risk and Compliance Management
+ Third Party Risk Management
+ Audit Management

* Good knowledge of SQL, JavaScript, and other scripting to support customization and automation.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem solving abilities.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.


**Good To Have (Preferred Qualifications)**
* Exposure to other GRC Platforms, such as:
+ ServiceNow GRC (SNOW)
+ IBM OpenPages
+ ProcessUnity
+ MetricStream, OneTrust, or other leading GRC tools

* Experience with API integrations and enterprise middleware.
* Understanding of broader GRC frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC2, NIST, SOX, Operational Risk, Vendor Risk, etc.).
* RSA Archer Certification(s) – Administrator or Developer – is a plus.


**Soft Skills**
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as in cross functional teams.
* Detail oriented with strong documentation and requirement analysis abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and deliver within timelines.


**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.

title: Software Test Engineer II
description:
**Description**
 Trintech is an award winning AI\-driven Fintech SaaS organisation and we are seeking a Software Test Engineer to be responsible for evaluating software solutions to ensure that it meets the specifications and requirements before being released to our customers. The Software Test Engineer II needs to identify functional, performance, or usability issues and suggest resolutions. Interacts with other engineering groups to define, document, analyze, perform, and interpret tests for products, systems, components, or modifications. In addition, Software Test Engineer II ensures testing procedures are in compliance with any required industry specific standards. Participates in designing and implementing testing processes and best practices to improve efficiency and effectiveness. Collaborate with cross\-functional teams of the Product to understand the requirements and client issues.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Responsible for end\-to\-end testing activities.
* Develop and execute test plans manually to validate software functionality against requirements and specifications.
* Identify, troubleshoot, report and track software defects and issues.
* Perform functional, performance, and regression testing of software products.
* Report test results and defects to the development team and other stakeholders and work on the resolution.
* Provide suggestions and feedback to improve the quality of the software development process across teams.
* Stay updated with industry trends and advancements in software testing methodologies and tools.
* Active participation in planning, analysis and estimation of backlog requirements.
* Ability to work in a close team environment, and engage with other departments.
* Able to work with minimal supervision and still meet job requirements and tight deadlines.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, especially around database, server OS, application servers to identify the root cause and suggest solutions.
* Learn automation tool (if new to automation) and automate the test cases.
* Learn performance testing tool (if new to performance testing) and run the performance test cases.


**Who You Are**
* Bachelor’s degree and prior work\-related experience or equivalent.
* 3\-5 years of related professional experience in Software testing.
* Good understanding of SDLC and STLC.
* Hands on experience on functional, systems testing including Test Planning, Test Cases Design, Test Data Setup, Defect Management, Test Execution, Traceability Matrix and Test Metrics.
* Knowledge of tools like JIRA is highly desired.
* Knowledge and experience using Oracle and SQL Server Database and SQL queries is preferable.
* Knowledge and experience in test automation(preferably selenium), performance testing (Loadrunner) is a plus.
* Excellent communication skills and an ability to effectively collaborate with all levels.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to both analyze and troubleshoot issues around product, third party software and databases.
* Proven ability to work in a fast paced environment and meet internal and external deadlines.
* Results and quality oriented with exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to work under minimum supervision in Agile/Scrum methodology.
* Previous experience with Reconciliation and/or month\-end close applications is preferred.


*At our core, Trintechers stand committed to fostering a culture rooted in our core values – Humble, Empowered, Reliable, and Open. Together, these values guide our actions, define our identity, and inspire us to continuously strive for excellence in everything we do.*
*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin or disability.*

title: Project Quality Engineer
description:
**Eykon Private Limited** 
 , formerly part of the Landis\+Gyr Group, supports electricity, gas, water and thermal utilities in managing increasingly complex networks, improving operational efficiency and enabling more sustainable use of resources.
   

  

  

  

 With more than
 **2\.800 employees in 19 countries** 
 and decades of experience in critical infrastructure technology, the company provides advanced metering, network intelligence and digital solutions to utilities and infrastructure operators primarily across Europe, Middle East and Africa. As a standalone organisation, Landis\+Gyr EMEA builds on long\-standing customer relationships and proven technology capabilities, backed by experienced regional teams.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Purpose and Objective
   

  

 To ensure firmware and software products are developed and released with the highest levels of quality, reliability, compliance, and customer satisfaction.
   

  

* Embed quality requirements throughout the product development lifecycle, from concept to release.
* Work collaboratively with engineering, project, manufacturing, and supplier teams to ensure successful product delivery.
* Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate quality and project risks before they impact customers or schedules.
* Ensure compliance with customer, industry, regulatory, and company quality standards.
* Drive defect prevention, root cause analysis, and corrective actions to improve product performance.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives that enhance development processes, product quality, and team effectiveness.
* Monitor quality metrics and provide independent quality oversight at key project milestones.
* Ensure products meet customer expectations and are fit for purpose before release.


 Key Performance Indicators
   

  

**Firmware/Software PQE Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
* Escaped Defect Rate: Percentage of defects discovered after release, measuring effectiveness of defect prevention and verification activities.
* Defect Detection Efficiency (DDE): Percentage of defects identified before release versus total defects found.
* Quality Gate Compliance: Percentage of projects passing phase/gate reviews on schedule with no major quality findings.
* Requirements Traceability Coverage: Percentage of requirements traced through design, testing, and validation to release.
* High\-Risk Closure Rate: Percentage of critical risks mitigated or closed before project milestones and release.
* Customer\-Reported Defects: Number of software/firmware defects reported by customer’s post\-release.
* CAPA Effectiveness: Percentage of corrective and preventive actions successfully implemented without recurrence.
* Continuous Improvement Delivery: Number and impact of implemented quality improvements resulting in reduced defects, improved compliance, or increased development efficiency.


**Overview Of The Role**
 The Firmware/Software Project Quality Engineer is responsible for ensuring software and firmware products are developed, verified, validated, and released in compliance with customer, regulatory, safety, cybersecurity, and quality requirements.
   

  

 The role provides independent quality governance throughout the development lifecycle, driving risk mitigation, defect prevention, process compliance, root cause analysis, continuous improvement, and customer satisfaction.
   

  

**Core Areas of Responsibility/Accountability**
* Lead quality planning and governance throughout the firmware/software development lifecycle.
* Ensure compliance with customer, regulatory, and business requirements.
* Drive risk management, including FMEA, CTQ identification, and mitigation activities.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to embed quality, reliability, and compliance into product development.
* Review and approve key quality deliverables, design documentation, and validation plans.
* Facilitate quality reviews, design reviews, and release readiness assessments.
* Drive root cause analysis, corrective actions, and defect prevention activities.
* Monitor quality metrics and provide project quality reporting and oversight.
* Support audits, supplier quality activities, NPI, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Act as the independent quality representative, ensuring products meet requirements and are delivered right first time.


 We value and encourage diversity in our team. This position is open to all qualified candidates regardless of gender, race, age, disability, sexual orientation, or background. We're committed to shaping a better future for everyone.

 and join us on our journey towards a greener tomorrow.

title: Forward-Deployed Engineer
description:
**About Uplevyl** 




 Uplevyl builds AI\-powered knowledge and community infrastructure for organizations serving women.
 



 Our products include UpGenie (our domain\-specific AI assistant), WeHub (our community platform), and UpSocial (a social platform for women).
 



 We work with mission\-driven partners to turn complex, high\-stakes information into clear, trustworthy guidance, and to build systems that create lasting impact.
 



 We hold a simple conviction: in high\-stakes domains like rights, law, and financial security, a generic AI is not enough. The answers people stake their lives and livelihoods on need a purpose\-built system with verified, native data. That is what we build, and it is why the work is urgent.
 



 AI is reshaping how the world learns, works, and earns, and the women we serve cannot afford to be left off that train.
 



 We have also made a deliberate choice about how we build: a small team of exceptional people, paid well above market, each doing work that would normally take several. We would rather be ten people who move the world than thirty who move paper.
 



 That choice sets the bar for every hire, including this one.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 A Forward\-Deployed Engineer (FDE) is an engineer who works where the product meets the client.
 



 You are the partner's point of contact and the person who makes our AI work in their world.
 



 At Uplevyl, our partners are mission\-driven organizations deploying UpGenie into domains where accuracy carries real consequences. Someone acting on one of our answers may be making a decision about their safety, their job, or their rights.
 



 The FDE owns that last mile: you sit in partner calls, understand what they actually need, configure and validate the system for their domain, and carry their feedback back into the product as clear engineering priorities.
 



 This role is equal parts technical depth and client trust. You will read the system well enough to debug it, and read the room well enough to run it.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




**Partner Relationship, End to End** 



* Be the named point of contact for a partner deployment.
* Run the delivery loop: UAT cycles, release notes, working sessions, and honest conversations when something needs more time.



**Deployment \& Configuration** 



* Stand up UpGenie for a partner's domain: their data, jurisdictions, and workflows.
* Own the gap between a working product and a working deployment.



**Answer Quality the Partner Can Trust** 



* Design and run testing that proves the system is right.
* Build structured test frameworks, error categorization, root\-cause analysis, and validation loops over underlying sources.
* When quality slips, identify why and drive the fix.



**Translation in Both Directions** 



* Turn a partner's ask into a specification and estimate that engineering can build against.
* Turn technical decisions into language a partner understands and agrees with.



**Delivery Workflows, Automated by You** 



* Build AI tooling that removes manual work from delivery.
* Create validation pipelines, testing harnesses, and reporting systems.
* Build these yourself rather than waiting on the core team.



  





**Who We're Looking For** 




 We hire across levels. A track record of building, shipping, and holding client trust matters more than years of experience, though real client\-facing engineering experience helps.
 


* **High Agency** 
 – You unblock yourself. When a deployment stalls or a partner escalates, you work out the next move and make it.
* **Technical Range** 
 – You can read a production AI system end to end: query the data, trace a wrong answer to its cause, script your own tooling, and hold your own in an architecture discussion. You use AI daily to build.
* **Client Presence** 
 – You are calm and credible in the room, including when something has gone wrong. Partners trust you because you are straight with them and you deliver.
* **Rigor Under Pressure** 
 – You test before you claim. In our domains, a wrong answer reaching a user is a serious failure, and you treat it that way.
* **Sharp Writing** 
 – Your release notes, status updates, and client emails are clear, honest, and tight.
* **A Builder Who Ships** 
 – You have things live that prove it: tools, integrations, internal systems. You follow the frontier and form your own view on what is useful versus hype.
* **Judgment** 
 – You know what to surface to a partner, what to resolve quietly, and when to pull in leadership.



  





**Even Better If** 



* You have worked as a Solutions Engineer, Forward\-Deployed Engineer, Technical Account Manager, or Technical Consultant.
* You have deployed or operated LLM or RAG systems in production.
* You have worked with legal, regulated, or otherwise high\-stakes data.
* You have worked in mission\-driven, social\-impact, women\-focused, or nonprofit ecosystems.
* You have founder, startup operator, or early\-employee experience.



  





**Before You Apply** 




 We want to be direct about what this is.

title: Spatial Reasoning Evaluation Specialist - Video RL
description:
**Role Overview:** 




  





 We are looking for Spatial Reasoning Evaluation Specialists to support a Video Reinforcement Learning (Video RL) program focused on AI\-generated videos, autonomous agents, physical\-AI simulations, and spatial reasoning. The role involves reviewing AI\-generated video outputs and evaluating whether the AI is performing actions correctly, logically, and realistically.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Review AI\-generated videos frame\-by\-frame and evaluate the correctness of actions and movements.
* Check temporal sequence, action order, and cause\-effect relationships in videos.
* Evaluate whether AI\-generated actions are aligned with the intended goal or task.
* Identify spatial, physical, visual, and motion\-related errors in AI outputs.
* Review video segmentation, bounding boxes, masks, object boundaries, and avatar/character movements.
* Identify issues such as visual hallucinations, unnatural physics, clipping, incorrect movements, and inconsistencies.
* Provide clear, structured and evidence\-based feedback explaining why an AI output is correct or incorrect.
* Support the creation and validation of ground\-truth datasets and edge\-case scenarios.



  





**Mandatory Requirements:** 




 Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in STEM \- Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, Data Science or related field.
 



  





**Relevant exposure to at least one of the following:** 



* Video Analysis
* Computer Vision
* AI/ML
* Reinforcement Learning
* Robotics / Simulation
* Video/Data Annotation
* AI Model Evaluation
* Strong spatial and temporal reasoning skills.
* Excellent attention to detail, particularly when analyzing visual content frame\-by frame.
* Ability to identify logical, physical and visual inconsistencies in videos.

**Job Description**

 Job Summary
   

  





 We are looking for a highly skilled
 **QC Engineer \- MEP \& BMS** 
 with 6\-7 years of experience in quality control and assurance of Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing (MEP), and Building Management Systems (BMS) projects. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring that all MEP and BMS installations, testing, commissioning, and documentation activities comply with project specifications, industry standards, regulatory requirements, and client expectations.
   

  





 The ideal candidate should possess strong technical knowledge of MEP systems, BMS controls, QA/QC procedures, inspections, testing protocols, and project documentation.
   

  





 Key Responsibilities
   

  





 Quality Control \& Inspection
   

  




* Implement and maintain project\-specific QA/QC plans, procedures, and inspection protocols.
* Conduct inspections of MEP and BMS installations to ensure compliance with approved drawings, specifications, and standards.
* Verify material deliveries, equipment installations, and workmanship quality at site.
* Prepare and manage Inspection Test Plans (ITPs), Method Statements, and Quality Checklists.
* Monitor installation activities and proactively identify quality issues and non\-conformities.



 MEP System Quality Assurance
   

  




* Ensure quality compliance for HVAC, electrical, plumbing, firefighting, ELV, and associated MEP systems.
* Verify installation of equipment such as chillers, AHUs, FCUs, pumps, transformers, switchgear, generators, and fire alarm systems.
* Review shop drawings, technical submittals, and material approvals from a quality perspective.
* Coordinate with consultants and project teams to resolve quality\-related observations.



 BMS Quality \& Testing
   

  




* Review and verify BMS installations, control panels, sensors, actuators, controllers, and field devices.
* Ensure correct integration of HVAC, Fire Alarm, Lighting Control, Energy Management, and other building automation systems.
* Monitor testing, functional checks, point\-to\-point verification, and commissioning activities.
* Validate BMS control logic and system performance against project requirements.



 Documentation \& Compliance
   

  




* Maintain QA/QC records, inspection reports, NCRs (Non\-Conformance Reports), and corrective action reports.
* Prepare quality documentation required for project audits and client submissions.
* Ensure all testing and commissioning reports are complete and properly documented.
* Support project handover by compiling quality dossiers and as\-built documentation.



 Testing \& Commissioning Support
   

  




* Witness testing and commissioning activities for MEP and BMS systems.
* Coordinate with commissioning teams, consultants, and contractors during system validation.
* Verify performance test results and ensure closure of punch\-list items.
* Ensure successful system handover and client acceptance.



 Stakeholder Coordination
   

  




* Work closely with project managers, site engineers, consultants, vendors, and subcontractors.
* Conduct quality awareness sessions and toolbox talks when required.
* Participate in project review meetings and provide quality status updates.


**Qualifications**

 Required Qualifications
   

  




* Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, or a related field.
* 6\-7 years of experience in QA/QC for MEP and BMS projects.
* Strong understanding of building services, automation systems, testing, and commissioning processes.
* Experience working on commercial buildings, data centers, healthcare facilities, industrial projects, or large infrastructure projects.

title: Functional Validation
description:
**OUR STORY**
**At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today.**
**When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50,000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world.**
**Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential.**
**Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you.**
**YOUR ROLE**
 Lab validation and characterization
   

  

 Attached to the Imaging Validation department, you will join a dynamic and innovative team, an integral part of R\&D, working on projects at the state of the art of image sensor technology targeting various markets and applications.
   

  

 As a Functional Validation Engineer, you will be involved in validating all the division products. This activity will aim to ensure the adequacy of the functionalities and performances of the product with the specifications by relying on FPGA prototyping first, and on circuit silicon in a second time.
   

  

 In this context, you will be responsible for developing the validation environment (definition of the tests suite, of the test bench in the laboratory, of the hardware, development of stimuli, automation, documentation). To do this, you will benefit from the different areas of technical expertise of our employees in testing, optics, electronics, mechanics, and software development.
   

  

 Throughout the validation, you will also oversee the analysis and resolution of technical challenges. Your product expertise may also be called upon to participate in customer support and integration.
   

  

 To succeed in these missions, you will work in close collaboration with all the different product development teams (Design, Architecture, Firmware and embedded software development), with our application teams in order to provide the best validation solution that will meet our customer's needs.
   

  

 You will also participate in project meetings, sharing information, actions, and priorities within the team.
   

  

 Finally, as a member of a validation team, you will reuse existing tools. You will also propose and participate in methods and tools for improvements.
   

  

**Your Skills \& Experiences**
* Object\-oriented programming languages (preferably Python, C)
* Version management tools (git, svn)
* Software, Hardware knowledge and debug capabilities.
* Knowledge:
* Embedded electronics / computing (real time)


 Exp: 7 to 12yrs
   

  

* Laboratory tools (oscilloscope, signal generator, etc.)
* Transmission protocols (high and low speed): I2C, I3C, SPI, MIPI
* Automation and/or continuous integration tools (ex: Jenkins, Gerrit, AI tools)
* Notions in image processing would be an adding competency.


 ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics \& integrity, purpose \& values, organization \& change, business strategy, and performance.

We strive for equity in career development, career opportunities, and equal remuneration. We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is woven into our company culture.

 Test coverage · Mentorship impact · Defect leakage rate · Quality improvements

 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

 You are someone who looks at a test failure and does not just log it, you dig until you understand why it happened and what it means for the next release. Scripting is not a chore for you, it is how you make repetitive work disappear so you can focus on the problems that actually need a human brain. You have spent enough time in labs or codebases to know that quality is not something you test in at the end, it is something you build into the process from the start.
   

  

 Data tells you stories. When you see a trend in regression results, you do not wait for someone else to notice, you pull the thread, ask the right questions, and surface what matters. You are comfortable working across teams, translating between what verification found, what design needs to know, and what a release checklist actually requires.
   

  

 You do not need years of experience to have a point of view. You know when a process is not working and you are not afraid to suggest a better way. At Synopsys, you will work on Embedded Memory IP that powers the devices people use every day, and the rigor you bring to testing and automation will directly affect whether those products ship on time and work as promised.
   

  

 What You'll Be Doing
   

  

* Run kickoff and release meetings across design, verification, and release teams, making sure compliance checkpoints are hit and nothing falls through the cracks
* Execute regression testing on Embedded Memory IP, catch issues before they reach customers, and track results across release cycles
* Analyze test data to spot trends, recurring failures, and process gaps that affect product quality or schedule
* Write and maintain Python and Tcl automation scripts that eliminate manual testing steps and speed up validation workflows
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to align on quality gates, release criteria, and issue resolution timelines
* Document test results, failure analysis, and process improvements in a way that helps the next engineer understand what happened and why


 The Impact You Will Have
   

  

* Ensure Embedded Memory IP on advanced process nodes ships with zero critical defects, directly affecting customer success and market readiness
* Reduce validation cycle time by automating repetitive test and data collection tasks, freeing engineers to focus on complex debug work
* Surface quality and process issues early in the development cycle, preventing costly delays and rework downstream
* Improve the reliability of regression infrastructure so teams can trust test results and make faster release decisions
* Strengthen compliance and traceability across the release process, reducing risk and audit friction
* Enable smarter decision\-making by turning raw test data into actionable insights for design and verification teams


 What You'll Need
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Electronics and Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field
* 2 years of experience in validation, testing, quality assurance, or a related engineering role
* Working knowledge of Python or Tcl for scripting and automation
* Ability to analyze data, identify patterns, and communicate findings clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences
* Familiarity with regression testing, release processes, or quality management systems is a plus
* Strong problem\-solving instincts and the ability to work across teams without losing track of details


 Who You Are
   

  

* You can look at a spreadsheet of test results and spot the one anomaly that matters, not just the loudest failure
* You write scripts that other people can actually read and modify six months later
* You are comfortable running a meeting with senior engineers and keeping it focused without being intimidated
* When a process does not make sense, you ask why before you follow it blindly
* You can explain a technical issue to a release manager in two sentences without losing the nuance
* You stay organized when managing multiple release tracks, test cycles, and compliance checkpoints at once


 The Team You'll Be Part Of
   

  

 Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process.
   

  

 Rewards and Benefits
   

  

 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

title: Field Quality Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
* Execute SQL queries to extract, clean, and analyze field performance metrics, repair data, and telemetry logs; identify and flag data anomalies for quality assessment.
* Perform end\-to\-end Failure Analysis (FA) on physical hardware samples, including board\-level debug and component diagnostics, and document findings in issue\-tracking databases.
* Conduct on\-site technical audits at repair centers and manufacturing partners, including inventory checks, root\-cause data collection, and physical hardware verification to validate repair procedures.
* Prepare detailed technical reports based on failure\-analysis investigations and data analysis, providing clear diagnostic evidence to support engineering decisions.
* Monitor bug trackers and quality databases to follow investigation progress, identify technical bottlenecks, and escalate issues based on data trends.
* Prepare regular standardized field\-quality reports using established templates and communicate key findings to relevant cross\-functional stakeholders.


**Key Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, or Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent technical experience.
* 0 \- 4 years of relevant experience in field quality, hardware failure analysis, repair engineering, manufacturing quality, or related technical areas.
* Strong proficiency in SQL for data extraction, cleaning, and analysis.
* Familiarity with board\-level diagnostic tools such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, and failure\-analysis software.
* Practical experience applying 5\-Why analysis, Fishbone diagrams, or similar root\-cause identification methods in a hardware environment.
* Ability to troubleshoot hardware issues and derive data\-backed insights with limited guidance.
* Ability to travel approximately 30–50% to service centers and manufacturing sites to conduct independent diagnostic and audit work.
* Good written and spoken English.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience in high\-volume consumer electronics manufacturing, connected\-device repair, service operations, or factory production environments.
* Hands\-on exposure to repair\-center audits, manufacturing\-site audits, or field\-quality investigations.
* Experience working with technical issue\-tracking systems, quality databases, or standardized reporting tools.
* Professional fluency in spoken and written Hindi and English to support local vendor communication, site activities, and regional cross\-functional collaboration.

title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
**Hello,**
**FCM part of FCTG** 
 is one of the world’s largest travel management companies and a trusted partner for nationals and multinational companies. With a 24/7 reach in 97 countries, FCM’s flexible technology anticipates and solves client needs, supported by experts who provide in\-depth local knowledge and duty of care as part of the ultimate personalised business travel experience.
   

  

 As part of the ASX\-listed Flight Centre Travel Group, FCM delivers the best market\-wide rates, unique added\-value benefits, and exclusive solutions.
   

  

**Winner of the World's Leading Travel Management Company Award at the WTM for nine consecutive years (2019\-2011\),** 
 FCM is constantly transforming the business of travel through its empowered and accountable people who deliver 24/7 service and are available online and offline. FCM has won the coveted
 **Great Place to Work certification for the fifth time** 
 ! FCM Travel India is one of India’s Top 100 Great Mid\-size Workplaces 2024 and the Best in Professional Services.
   

  

 A leader in the travel tech space, FCM has proprietary client solutions. FCM provides specialist services via FCM Consulting and FCM Meetings \& Events.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for a Senior Quality Engineer to join our scrum team as a hands\-on quality champion. This is an individual\-contributor role, but you'll be expected to lead by influence — raising the bar for how the whole team thinks about testing and quality. You'll be embedded from day one of refinement through release, testing across the stack, and coaching engineers to build quality in rather than bolt it on afterward.
   

  

**Day in the life:**
* Design and execute tests across API, integration, end\-to\-end, and admin interface layers
* Test decoupled and headless architectures, including API contract testing between backend services and consuming frontends
* Participate actively in backlog refinement, bringing a testing and quality lens to story definition and acceptance criteria
* Coach and mentor engineers on quality practices — testable design, effective test strategy, and shared ownership of quality
* Build, maintain, and evolve testing tooling and integrations within CI pipelines
* Partner closely with developers, product managers, and other quality engineers to identify risk areas and prioritize test coverage
* Continuously improve test suites for reliability, speed, and maintainability


**You'll be perfect for the role if you have:**
* 7\+ years of experience in quality/test engineering (10\+ years preferred)
* Strong experience testing APIs, integrations, end\-to\-end flows, and admin/back\-office interfaces
* Proven experience testing decoupled or headless architectures, with hands\-on API contract testing between services and frontends
* Comfort working in JavaScript and TypeScript
* Practical experience with:
* E2E/UI testing: Playwright or Cypress
* Unit/integration testing: Jest
* Contract testing: Pactum
* API tooling: Postman or Bruno
* CI/CD: GitHub Actions
* Experience embedding quality practices into agile/scrum ceremonies, particularly refinement
* Strong communication skills and comfort coaching other engineers without formal authority


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience with performance and load testing


**Work Perks! \- What’s in it for you:**
 FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.
   

  

 You will be rewarded with competitive market salary. You will also be equipped with relevant training courses and tools to set you up for success with endless career advancement and job opportunities all over the world.
   

  

**Market Aligned remuneration structure** 
 and a highly competitive salary
   

  

**Fun and Energetic culture** 
 : At the heart of everything we do at FCM is a desire to have fun and be yourself
   

  

**Work life Balance** 
 : We believe in “No Leave \= No Life” So have your own travel adventures with paid annual leave
   

  

**Great place to work** 
 \- Recognized as a top workplace for 5 consecutive years, which is a testimonial of our commitment towards our people
   

  

**Wellbeing Focus** 
 \- We take care of our employee with comprehensive medical coverage, accidental insurance, and term insurance for the well being of our people.
   

  

**Paternity Leave:** 
 We ensure that you can spend quality time with your growing family
   

  

**Travel perks** 
 : You'll have access to plenty of industry discounts to ensure you continue to broaden your horizons
   

  

**A career, not a job** 
 : We believe in our people brightness of future. As a high growth company, you will have the opportunity to advance your career in any direction you choose whether that is locally or globally.
   

  

**Reward \& Recognition** 
 : Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering \- You'll have to experience it to believe it!
   

  

**Love for travel** 
 : We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
   

  

**We value you...**
 Flight Centre Travel Group is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace that supports your unique identity to create better, safer experiences for everyone. We encourage you to come as you are; to foster inclusivity and collaboration. We celebrate you.
   

  

**Who We Are...**
 Since our beginning, our vision has always been to open up the world for those who want to see.
   

  

 As a global travel retailer, our people come from all different backgrounds, and our connections spread to the far reaches of the globe \- 20\+ countries and counting! Together, we are a family (we call ourselves Flighties).
   

  

 We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve. We embrace new experiences, we celebrate the wins, seize all opportunities, and empower all of our people to find their
 **Brightness of Future.**
 We encourage you to
 **DREAM BIG** 
 through collaboration and innovation, and make sure you are supported to make incredible ideas a reality. Together, we deliver quality, innovative solutions that delight our customers and achieve our strategic priorities.
   

  

**Irreverence. Ownership. Egalitarianism \#FCMIN**

title: Technical Lead
description:
Location: Noida Berger Tower, India
   

  

 Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
   

  

 Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber \& Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India \- one in Noida focused on Cyber \& Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair \& Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 As a Quality Engineer Technical Lead, you will be expected to lead the quality engineering strategy for the team with strong ownership of automation, performance validation, test reliability, and production\-quality observability. You will drive and maintain the Automation Suite framework used across the team, define scalable automation practices, strengthen regression and integration coverage, and ensure that quality gates are embedded effectively across delivery pipelines. The role requires strong hands\-on exposure to performance testing, troubleshooting distributed applications in Kubernetes environments, and using observability tools such as Datadog and logging frameworks to diagnose issues, improve system reliability, and support faster root\-cause analysis. Along with individual contribution, you will mentor engineers, guide test design, improve engineering productivity, support customer escalations, and continuously enhance the overall quality posture of the product.
   

  

**Job Requirement And Responsibilities**
* The Quality Engineer Technical Lead will be responsible for leading the quality engineering charter for the team, including automation strategy, test framework ownership, performance validation, release quality, and continuous improvement of testing practices.
* Own, maintain, and evolve the Automation Suite framework used by the whole team, ensuring that it is scalable, reliable, maintainable, and easy for engineers to extend across functional, regression, integration, and API test scenarios.
* Define automation best practices, coding standards, reusable utilities, test data strategies, reporting mechanisms, and execution patterns that improve team productivity and reduce manual validation effort.
* Build and strengthen a robust suite of performance tests covering key product workflows, scalability scenarios, load profiles, reliability checks, and performance regression detection.
* Work closely with development, DevOps, and product teams to embed quality gates into CI/CD pipelines and ensure that automation, regression, and performance feedback is available early in the delivery lifecycle.
* Provide strong troubleshooting support for issues observed in Kubernetes\-based deployments, including pod failures, service connectivity, resource constraints, configuration issues, and environment\-related problems.
* Use observability platforms such as Datadog, application logs, metrics, dashboards, traces, and logging frameworks to perform root\-cause analysis and support faster resolution of production and pre\-production issues.
* Mentor quality engineers and developers on automation design, testability, performance analysis, defect investigation, and engineering practices that improve overall product quality.
* Support customer escalations by reproducing issues, analyzing logs and telemetry, validating fixes, and ensuring relevant automated coverage is added to prevent recurrence.
* Drive continuous improvements in automation reliability, execution speed, test coverage, performance benchmarking, observability, and quality engineering processes.


**Job Knowledge, Skill And Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, Electronics and Communication, or a related discipline, with 7\+ years of experience in quality engineering, test automation, performance testing, and technical leadership.
* Strong hands\-on experience in designing, developing, maintaining, and scaling automation frameworks for API, UI, integration, regression, and end\-to\-end test coverage.
* Proven ability to lead an Automation Suite framework for a team or program, including framework architecture, reusable components, test orchestration, reporting, maintainability, and adoption by multiple engineers.
* Good programming skills in Java, Python, JavaScript, or a comparable language used for automation development, test utilities, scripting, and framework enhancements.
* Strong experience with performance testing tools and practices, including load testing, scalability testing, baseline creation, bottleneck identification, trend analysis, and performance regression validation.
* Good troubleshooting exposure in Kubernetes\-based environments, including deployments, pods, services, ingress, configuration, resource utilization, logs, and common runtime issues.
* Hands\-on exposure to observability and monitoring tools such as Datadog, with the ability to analyze dashboards, metrics, traces, alerts, and service health indicators.
* Strong understanding of logging frameworks and log analysis practices to support debugging, defect triaging, root\-cause analysis, and production issue investigation.
* Experience integrating automation suites with CI/CD pipelines and ensuring automated quality gates are reliable, actionable, and aligned with release expectations.
* Exposure to cloud\-native applications, microservices, Docker, Kubernetes, and distributed system behavior will be an important factor.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to connect automation failures, performance trends, logs, metrics, and deployment behavior to identify issues quickly and accurately.
* Ability to mentor team members, review automation code, improve test design, promote quality ownership, and collaborate effectively with engineering, DevOps, and product stakeholders.


**What do we offer?**
 At Thales we provide CAREERS and not only jobs. With Thales employing 80,000 employees in 68 countries our mobility policy enables thousands of employees each year to develop their careers at home and abroad, in their existing areas of expertise or by branching out into new fields. Together we believe that embracing flexibility is a smarter way of working. Great journeys start here, apply now!
   

  

 At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: Quality Assurance Test Engineer
description:
**Typesider \| Noida \| Hybrid \| Full\-time \| 0–3 Years** 




 Compensation:
 **₹3–5 LPA** 




  




**About Typesider** 

 Typesider is a reward based Windows desktop application that turns everyday computer activity into tangible rewards.
 



 Users earn Typoints based on keyboard keystrokes and mouse clicks while using their computers normally. Typoints can be redeemed for coupons, discounts, exclusive brand offers, and soon, cashback.
 



 Typesider is designed to work seamlessly in the background and follows a privacy first approach. It counts activity volume but does not read, record, or store what users type or the content of their computer activity.
 



 We’re building a consumer product where reliability, usability, privacy, and trust are critical.
   




**About the Role** 

 We’re looking for a Quality Assurance Test Engineer to help us test and improve Typesider as we continue developing and releasing the product.
 



 You’ll work closely with the product and development teams to test the Windows application, identify bugs, explore edge cases, and ensure new features work reliably for real users.
 



 This is a hands on role where you’ll have a direct impact on product quality.
   




**What You’ll Do** 

 • Test the Typesider Windows desktop application across different user scenarios
 



 • Create, document, and execute manual test cases and test scenarios
 



 • Perform functional, regression, exploratory, integration, and usability testing
 



 • Test the complete user journey, including installation, onboarding, streaks, reward days, reward claims, and redemption
 



 • Test new features and product updates before release
 



 • Identify bugs, edge cases, and usability issues
 



 • Document bugs clearly with steps to reproduce, expected behavior, actual behavior, severity, and supporting information
 



 • Verify fixes and perform regression testing
 



 • Test different Windows environments and user scenarios
 



 • Work closely with developers and the product team to understand and resolve issues
 



 • Think like a real user and identify issues that could impact trust, engagement, retention, and overall experience
 



 • Help improve testing processes and documentation as the product grows
   




**What We’re Looking For** 

 • 0–3 years of experience in QA, software testing, or a related field
 



 • Freshers and candidates with 1–3 years of experience are welcome to apply
 



 • Good understanding of manual testing and software testing principles
 



 • Ability to create and execute clear test cases and test scenarios
 



 • Understanding of functional, regression, exploratory, integration, and usability testing
 



 • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify bugs and edge cases
 



 • Ability to write clear and reproducible bug reports
 



 • Good analytical and problem solving skills
 



 • Strong written and verbal communication skills
 



 • Comfortable working closely with developers and product teams
 



 • Willingness to explore a product deeply and question how things work
   




**Good to Have** 

 • Experience testing Windows desktop applications
 



 • Familiarity with Jira or similar bug tracking tools
 



 • Basic understanding of API testing
 



 • Exposure to automation testing or QA automation tools
 



 • Experience testing consumer software or applications involving rewards, subscriptions, payments, or user accounts
   




**What We Value** 

 We’re looking for someone who doesn't just follow a checklist.
 



 A good QA engineer should be able to ask:
 



 What happens if the user does this?
 



 What happens if the system fails here?
 



 Can this feature be misunderstood or misused?
 



 Does this actually work the way a real user would expect?
 



 Your ability to think through these scenarios and uncover problems will be a major part of the role.
   




**Why Join Typesider** 

 Typesider is an early stage consumer product, so you’ll have the opportunity to work closely with the team building the product and see your work directly influence releases.
 



 You’ll be testing a product used by real users and helping build the quality standards and QA processes as the product grows.
   




**Work Details** 

 Experience: 0–3 Years
 



 Compensation: ₹3–5 LPA
 



 Employment Type: Full\-time
 



 Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh
 



 Work Mode: Hybrid
 



 Working Days: Monday to Friday
 



 Working Hours: 10AM \- 6PM

**Job Description**
 WSP is seeking a Senior Quality Assurance Lead to establish and lead practical QA practices for our Digital Environment development team. This hands\-on role will define quality strategy, improve delivery processes, guide testing activities, and promote shared ownership of quality across the software development lifecycle.
   

  

 The team delivers data management, software development, and web\-based weather information services for internal and external clients using cloud technologies and Agile delivery practices.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Quality Strategy, Governance \& Process Leadership
   

  

* Define and implement a practical QA strategy, operating model, standards, roadmap, and supporting templates.
* Assess current practices, identify quality risks and process gaps, and prioritize measurable improvements.
* Establish quality gates, release\-readiness practices, defect workflows, and test evidence expectations.


 Test Planning, Automation \& Execution
   

  

* Lead risk\-based test planning for features, integrations, data workflows, and production releases.
* Perform and oversee manual and automated testing across web, API, data\-processing, and mobile solutions.
* Develop and maintain the team’s test automation approach, including standards and CI/CD integration.
* Track defects and quality risks, support timely resolution, and turn findings into process improvements.


 Team Leadership \& Capability Development
   

  

* Provide technical direction, mentoring, and coordination for QA professionals and others performing testing.
* Help shape QA roles, responsibilities, recruitment, onboarding, and future team structure.


 Collaboration \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Participate in Agile planning, refinement, stand\-ups, demonstrations, retrospectives, and release planning.
* Provide evidence\-based recommendations on product quality, release readiness, and material risks.
* Promote shared ownership of quality rather than treating QA as a final testing step.
